name: veritrace
description: Batch provenance and recall cascade engine: PostgreSQL + Neo4j + Qdrant behind a Next.js app

scripts.setup: npm run db:schema && npm run db:seed && npm run db:indexes && npm run graph:setup && npm run graph:resync && npm run vectors:resync && npm run complaints:seed
scripts.docs:er: python3 docs/er/build_er.py && neato -Tsvg docs/er/er-diagram.dot -o docs/er/er-diagram.svg && neato -Tpng -Gdpi=150 docs/er/er-diagram.dot -o docs/er/er-diagram.png
scripts.docs:schema: tsx scripts/schema-diagram.ts && dot -Tsvg docs/er/relational-schema.dot -o docs/er/relational-schema.svg && dot -Tpng -Gdpi=150 docs/er/relational-schema.dot -o docs/er/relational-schema.png
